components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Browser preview of native primary control; px represents unscaled dp. Native system text scaling and accessibility require device verification. No authored hover treatment.
components.css: .jom-primary { background:#006653; color:#FFFFFF; min-width:48px; min-height:48px; padding:12px 16px; border:2px solid transparent; border-radius:12px; font:600 16px/23px system-ui,sans-serif; text-align:center; } .jom-primary:active { opacity:0.7; } .jom-primary:focus-visible { border-color:#163FAD; } .jom-primary:disabled { background:#E2E6DF; color:#59645D; }

components.name: Selected Route Card
components.description: Browser preview of selected native route card; facts below are explicitly demo values, not routing results.
components.css: .jom-route { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; padding:16px; min-height:48px; border:2px solid #006653; border-radius:16px; background:#E4F1E9; color:#172F2C; text-align:left; font:400 16px/23px system-ui,sans-serif; } .jom-top { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; } .jom-top strong { font-size:18px; line-height:24px; font-weight:600; } .jom-top span { font-size:14px; line-height:20px; font-weight:600; } .jom-eta { font-size:24px; line-height:30px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.4px; } .jom-route:active { opacity:0.7; } .jom-route:focus-visible { border-color:#163FAD; }

narrative.overview: Phase 2 native Android mock planner with solid surfaces, system typography, a deep teal accent, explicit selection labels, and plain-language route trade-offs. Light only. The harness remains the execution authority; this snapshot does not certify native QA.
keyCharacteristics: Map legend/footer outside geometry; A/B markers scale with system text
Community and unknown confidence use warning color plus text
Navigation tabs expose a 2dp focus border
dos: Do reuse central tokens and preserve system scaling.
Do expose selection and confidence with text.
Do label fixed routes and schematic geography as demo information.
Do keep demo URL fixtures and state controls development-only; release ignores fixture parameters.
donts: Don't convert unknown accessibility into accessible data.
Don't treat a preview or export as native acceptance evidence.
